The '''Morjanssik Mine''' was a mine in the city of [[Morjanssik]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Thulwuk Thur]] worked there as a foreman, and led [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents into the mine while they were investigating [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] saboteurs.
